flags.observation: Beat one drops "Kayfabe" from the deck title; the thesis itself is plain and concrete.
Stand-up setup lands, but "Airline puts?" is unexplained insider jargon for normies; no beat says who speaks or what we are doing here.
"Kayfabe-Money!, analog" punctuation collision breaks the breath right after the card name.
"Audit:" is a label, not a therefore/but bridge; the stacked double colon makes the beat stumble.
"Coin toss:" is a pun label with no causal or twisting link to the previous card.
"nullify investigation" recites the power as a rule rather than an aside or inversion.
"agreed to a ninety-nine-year WTC lease signed" is ungrammatical and merges the 1998 privatization agreement with the 2001 lease.
Opener "insurers send a bill" invents an event; the card is about own money and leverage, not insurance.
125 characters, beyond one breath; trailing "empire" is a dangling fragment from the power text.
"A second premium follows" lets a thing drive the bridge and extends the invented insurer-bill thread; props, not people.
"paid back initial equity and control" implies control was handed back; the card says control was maintained.
The card claim "exact impact zone of the North Tower" is absent; the line is a bare noun list.
"specific and commercial" is a meaningless splice; the card claim "first financial company on the planet" is lost.
"The purchase orders survive" gives documents agency and adds a survival event the card does not contain.
"The data surfaces" makes data the acting subject of the bridge.
"That recovery exposes" lets an abstraction act and asserts a causal link the 40-minute card does not state.
The ironic Convar quote, the card core, is gone; only the power phrase "random market fluctuations" remains.
"That trading frenzy feeds" is abstraction-acting; same thing-as-subject opener pattern recurs in beats 9, 13, 15, 16, 27.
121 characters; opener "Investigators request the paper trail" restates the card's own FOIA request and overloads the breath.
"firm formerly chaired by CIA" says the agency chaired the firm; the card says "the current #3 man at the CIA".
"The inquiry meets a verdict" lets an abstraction act.
Dangling "advanced knowledge" reads as an SEC finding; the card inverts it: "those who had advanced knowledge didn't trade".
140 characters, far beyond one breath.
"who audits the auditors" is a stock phrase that fits any song; the outro ends on a question, not a clear statement.
